name: Blueberry Hill Farms & Nursery
description: Blueberry Hill Farms & Nursery is an agritourism farm in 884 Roberts Rd, NY, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
